title: Story premise EDU035: The Confidence Stamp Audit
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (learning/study). Hook: How sure are you before the answer flips over? Takeaway/theme: Compare confidence with checked performance instead of relying on familiarity alone.
description: A quiz maker wants to judge readiness, but stamps every familiar-looking answer as certain. Comparing confidence stamps with checked answers reveals which judgments need recalibration.
